card.name: Last word of a table column header
card.fires_on: The final word of a column heading in a dosing or preparation table, just before the table's first row of values begins. Often seen in headings like creatinine clearance mL/min, drug name or dose, or diluent.

modes.label: Renal clearance headers
modes.description: The unit or last word of a creatinine clearance column heading in a renal dosing table.
modes.example: Renal Status Creatinine Clearance mL<</min>> Initial Dose mg/day Normal Renal

modes.label: Preparation table headers
modes.description: The last word of a column heading in a reconstitution, dilution or dose-modification table.
modes.example: Table 5: Diluted EPYSQLI Solution Storage Conditions Dil<<uent>> Used to Prepare Solution for Infusion Dil
